Caroline / Steph — reviewed the doc and pulled out the core commercial asks. Short summary + suggested compromise below.

Summary of redlines we see:
- Pass-through: MarketCloud wants explicit language that marketplace transaction fees may be passed to the reseller/end-customer. Redwood is OK with pass-through but needs visibility and a cap mechanism.
- Indemnity carve-out: MarketCloud asked for a carve-out that limits Redwood's liability for marketplace-listed integrations; that is a no-go without clearer scope.
- Billing reconciliation: need a monthly reconciliation window and a contact for ops.

Suggested language (for §3.2 - pass-through):
"Marketplace transaction fees incurred by the reseller in connection with listing or selling Redwood services via MarketCloud's marketplace may be passed through to the reseller, provided that MarketCloud provides Redwood with written notice of such fees and supporting invoices at least thirty (30) days prior to pass-through; Redwood's liability under this Agreement shall not be increased due to such pass-throughs, and any fee passed through shall be limited to fees actually charged by the marketplace operator."

We attached a tracked-changes suggested markup for your team to review. We think this preserves MarketCloud's ability to pass fees through while giving Redwood the visibility and documentation to reconcile.

Attachment: Redwood_Suggested_Markup.docx

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal (Rachel) does a line-by-line on the redline and the suggested language.
2) Ops mapping call (30m) next week to confirm invoicing flow (MarketCloud ops + Redwood billing).

If that works for you, Caroline, can we tentatively schedule Ops on Wed Aug 4th?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum - pass-through fees (Redwood legal comments)

Caroline / team — thanks for the redline and Marcus' suggested language. I've reviewed both the MarketCloud redline and our suggested edits. High-level legal position below, followed by proposed final language.

High level legal notes:
- Pass-through: Acceptable in principle. We require (a) prior written notice and supporting documentation, (b) a cap to prevent unexpected third-party marketplace surcharge markup, and (c) a simple dispute / reconciliation mechanism (30-day invoice dispute window).
- Indemnity carve-out: We cannot accept a broad indemnity carve-out as drafted. We can agree to limited marketplace-related carve-outs narrowly tied to negligence by the marketplace operator, but not to waive Redwood's remedies for breaches by the reseller.
- Order Form alignment: Any fees passed through by MarketCloud must either appear as a line item on MarketCloud's invoice or be shown on the Order Form between Redwood and the reseller; we prefer the latter for customer visibility.

Proposed final clause (to replace §3.2):
"Marketplace Fees: Marketplace transaction fees charged by the marketplace operator may be passed through to the reseller provided MarketCloud (i) provides Redwood with written notice and supporting documentation of such fees at least thirty (30) days prior to pass-through; (ii) limits any pass-through to fees actually charged by the marketplace operator (no markup); and (iii) allows Redwood and the reseller a thirty (30) day period following receipt of invoice to dispute any such fees in accordance with the Agreement's dispute resolution process."

We redlined the indemnity carve-out to a narrow sentence that reads: "Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, neither party's obligations to indemnify the other for claims arising from a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct shall be limited by marketplace listing terms; marketplace-specific liabilities shall be apportioned to the party whose acts or omissions gave rise to the claim."

Attachment: Redwood_Legal_Commented_Addendum.pdf (redline + comments)

Action items for MarketCloud ops: please confirm whether pass-through will show on the MarketCloud invoice or on the reseller Order Form. If on MarketCloud invoice, confirm the data fields provided for reconciliation (invoice ID, marketplace transaction id, reseller identifier).

I'll be on standby to iterate quickly — we think this is signable with the suggested tweaks.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

Rachel / Marcus / Steph — thanks for the detailed review and the suggested language. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

We are generally comfortable with the proposed §3.2 language with two small edits:
1) MarketCloud will provide Marketplace fee invoices and supporting transaction-level detail; those will be shown on the MarketCloud invoice (not on the Order Form). We will include the marketplace transaction id and reseller identifier.
2) We need the pass-through to be effective upon MarketCloud charging the reseller (so 0-30 day notice is acceptable operationally); we'll accept the 30-day notice language so long as historical / already-processed fees are eligible for reconciliation in the subsequent invoice run.

We reviewed the indemnity note and accept the narrowed carve-out you proposed.
